Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a tax credit for syrup sales.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to syrup taxes; adding a new section to chapter82.04 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In computing the tax imposed under this chapter, a taxpayer mayclaim a credit for all taxes imposed under RCW 82.64.020 and paid to awholesaler or to the department. (2) Credits shall not exceed the amount of tax paid by the taxpayerunder this chapter during the reporting period. Credits in excess oftax paid under this chapter in a reporting period may be carriedforward to future reporting periods for a maximum of one year. (3) For the purposes of this section, "taxpayer" does not includea wholesaler with respect to tax collected by the wholesaler and paidto the department under RCW 82.64.050.
